name: Dorothy
source:
A girl newly assigned to Ikeno in Paradise. She is a lively and simple girl, but her body is weak.

At the beginning of the story, she is depressed by the gap between her identity as "Dorothy" and her physically weak body, which tires easily and does not perform as expected. However, she is energized by the "three followers" portrayed by Ikeno, and gradually begins to behave in a lively, Dorothy-like manner.

[translated from [url=https://www.liar.co.jp/fairy_encore/index.html]official website[/url]]
